en.title: How to Get Government Legal Aid in Bangladesh
en.directAnswer: Bangladesh has a government legal-aid system for eligible people and cases. The National Legal Aid Services organisation/department provides information, district legal-aid offices, forms and online application routes. Eligibility and services depend on current law and rules.

atAGlance.whoFor: A person cannot afford legal help or wants to know whether government legal aid can assist.
atAGlance.legalBasis: Legal Aid Services Act, 2000; Legal Aid Services (Amendment) Act, 2026; current NLASO rules and forms.
atAGlance.mainRule: The legal-aid law was amended in 2026. Use current eligibility, mediation and service rules rather than older brochures.
atAGlance.updateStatus: LAW UPDATED: Legal Aid Services (Amendment) Act, 2026 (Act No. 45 of 2026). Re-check current eligibility and forms before publication.

en.lawMeaning: The legal-aid law was amended in 2026. Use current eligibility, mediation and service rules rather than older brochures. This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Check the type of help available.
Complete the official form or online application.
Follow instructions from the legal-aid office.
evidence: Identity; income/eligibility information; case documents; court papers; opponent information where required; contact details.
en.simpleExample: A person with a pending family dispute cannot afford a private lawyer. They should check the current legal-aid eligibility and apply through the official district or online route instead of paying an unknown intermediary.
commonMistakes: Common mistakes: Using a fake “legal aid” Facebook page.
Common mistakes: submitting an incomplete case history.
Common mistakes: assuming every case is automatically eligible..

whatIf.question: What if a case is already in court?
whatIf.answer: Legal aid may still be relevant depending on eligibility and service.

whatIf.answer: Check the current legal-aid mediation framework.

whatIf.question: What if you cannot apply online?
